```{r tr-figures, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
  scale_fill_manual(values = rtsl_scn_cols(unique(as.character(hl$scenario))), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)), labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Deaths delayed (millions)", y = NULL) + tr_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
f06_data <- data.frame(Scenario = clean_label(scenario_labels[as.character(hl$scenario)]),
  deaths_delayed = hl$deaths_delayed, deaths_delayed_millions = hl$deaths_delayed / 1e6)
add_fig("headline", "Deaths delayed by intervention, ranked",
  basename(save_tr_fig(p_f06, "fig_tr_headline.png", 8.5, 4)), 8.5, 4,
  data = f06_data,
  units = "Millions of cardiovascular deaths delayed vs. baseline (bar labels in millions)",
  period = WINDOW, population = POP_ADULT,
  notes = paste0("Cumulative deaths delayed over ", WINDOW, " across ", n_pri, " countries, one ",
    "bar per scenario. Colours denote intervention family (packaged-food levers, procurement, ",
    "salt tax, full package, salt substitutes). The full package and salt substitutes are ",
    "separate strategies and are not additive. Salt-substitute bars are benefit-only."),
  source = REPORT_SOURCE)

# f07: full-package deaths delayed by country as a PARETO chart (comment F) ----
par_dt <- dd_cs[scenario == "full_package", .(location, deaths_delayed)][order(-deaths_delayed)]
par_dt[, `:=`(country = factor(location, levels = location),
              cum = cumsum(deaths_delayed) / sum(deaths_delayed))]
par_dt[, cum_prev := shift(cum, fill = 0)]
par_dt[, within80 := cum_prev < 0.80]              # bars needed to reach ~80%
maxbar <- max(par_dt$deaths_delayed) / 1e3         # thousands; 100% aligns to the tallest bar
n80    <- sum(par_dt$within80)
cty80  <- paste(as.character(par_dt$location[par_dt$within80]), collapse = ", ")
p_f07 <- ggplot(par_dt, aes(x = country)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = deaths_delayed / 1e3, fill = within80), width = 0.72) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80 * maxbar, linetype = "dashed", colour = RTSL$divider) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum * maxbar, group = 1), colour = RTSL$orange, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cum * maxbar), colour = RTSL$orange, size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RTSL$purple, `FALSE` = RTSL$lpurple2),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Accounts for ~80% of total", `FALSE` = "Remaining countries"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Deaths delayed (thousands)", labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / maxbar, name = "Cumulative share of 10-country total",
                        breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1))) +
  labs(x = NULL) + tr_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = RTSL$orange),
        axis.text.y.right  = element_text(colour = RTSL$orange),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
f07_data <- data.frame(Country = as.character(par_dt$location),
  deaths_delayed = par_dt$deaths_delayed, cumulative_share = round(par_dt$cum, 4))
add_fig("countries", "Full package: deaths delayed by country (Pareto)",
  basename(save_tr_fig(p_f07, "fig_tr_countries.png", 8.5, 4.6)), 8.5, 4.6,
  data = f07_data,
  units = "Bars: thousands of deaths delayed (left axis). Line: cumulative share of the ten-country total (right axis, 0–100%).",
  period = WINDOW, population = POP_ADULT,
  notes = paste0("Countries are ranked from largest to smallest absolute deaths delayed under the ",
    "full package. Bars (left axis) give each country's deaths delayed; the orange line (right axis) ",
    "is the running cumulative share of the ten-country total and ends at 100%. The right axis is a ",
    "fixed rescaling of the left (100% aligns to the tallest bar), not an independent scale. The ",
    "dashed line marks 80%: the ", n80, " highest-impact countries (", cty80, ") together account ",
    "for about 80% of the total, so impact is highly concentrated in the largest countries."),
  source = REPORT_SOURCE)

# (Comment G) The full-package deaths-delayed-by-cause figure was removed as
# redundant to the by-cause TABLE; the table is retained (add_tab("bycause")).

s2_dd <- merge(s2_dd, s2_reg[, .(scenario, cov)], by = "scenario")
```

```{r tr-bundle, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# -------------------------------------------------------------- tr-numbers ----
ddc_scn <- function(scn) { v <- dd_cum[as.character(scenario) == scn, deaths_delayed]
  if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }
pkg_base   <- ddc_scn("full_package")
pkg_pct    <- dd_cum[as.character(scenario) == "full_package", pct_vs_base][1]
pkg_peryr  <- dd_cum[as.character(scenario) == "full_package", per_year][1]
china_pkg  <- dd_cs[scenario == "full_package" & location == "China", deaths_delayed]
top_cause  <- dd_cause_pkg[1]
s2_lo <- s2_reg$scenario[which.min(s2_reg$cov)]; s2_hi <- s2_reg$scenario[which.max(s2_reg$cov)]

TRnums <- list(
  n_countries   = n_pri,
  window        = WINDOW,
  scaleup       = paste0(SCALEUP_YEAR1, "–", SCALEUP_YEAR2),
  horizon       = RC$analysis_years[2],
  results_years = paste(RC$impact_years, collapse = ", "),
  pkg_m         = fmtm(pkg_base, 2),
  pkg_pct       = pct(pkg_pct, 1),
  pkg_peryr_k   = fmtk(pkg_peryr, 0),
  china_pkg_m   = fmtm(china_pkg, 2),
  china_share   = pct(china_pkg / pkg_base, 0),
  salt_targets_m = fmtm(ddc_scn("salt_targets"), 2),
  fopl_m         = fmtm(ddc_scn("fopl"), 2),
  public_m       = fmtm(ddc_scn("public_procurement"), 2),
  fiscal_base_m  = fmtm(ddc_scn("fiscal_base"), 2),
  fiscal_low_m   = fmtm(ddc_scn("fiscal_low"), 2),
  fiscal_high_m  = fmtm(ddc_scn("fiscal_high"), 2),
  pkg_low_m      = fmtm(ddc_scn("full_package_low"), 2),
  pkg_high_m     = fmtm(ddc_scn("full_package_high"), 2),
  lss_s2_lo_m    = fmtm(ddc_scn(s2_lo), 2),
  lss_s2_hi_m    = fmtm(ddc_scn(s2_hi), 2),
  lss_s2_lo_pct  = paste0(round(100 * min(s2_reg$cov)), "%"),
  lss_s2_hi_pct  = paste0(round(100 * max(s2_reg$cov)), "%"),
  lss_s4_m       = fmtm(ddc_scn("lss_s4"), 2),
  lss_s5_m       = fmtm(ddc_scn("lss_s5"), 2),
  top_cause      = tolower(cause_map[top_cause$cause]),
  top_cause_m    = fmtm(top_cause$deaths_delayed, 2),
  top_cause_pct  = pct(top_cause$deaths_delayed / sum(dd_cause_pkg$deaths_delayed), 0),
  lss_nacl       = pct(RC$lss$nacl_fraction, 0),
  lss_kcl        = pct(RC$lss$kcl_fraction, 0),
  lss_adherence  = formatC(RC$lss$adherence, format = "f", digits = 2),
  fiscal_base_red = pct(RC$fiscal$base_effect, 0),
  fiscal_tax      = pct(RC$fiscal$base$tax_rate, 0),
  bench_ratio    = if (exists("bench_ratio_tot") && is.finite(bench_ratio_tot))
                     formatC(bench_ratio_tot, format = "f", digits = 2) else "n/a",
  bench_cur_m    = if (exists("bench_cur_tot")  && is.finite(bench_cur_tot))  fmtm(bench_cur_tot, 2)  else "n/a",
  bench_prev_m   = if (exists("bench_prev_tot") && is.finite(bench_prev_tot)) fmtm(bench_prev_tot, 2) else "n/a"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------- tr-dictionary --
DICT <- data.frame(
  Term = c("Deaths delayed", "Total sodium reduction fraction (η)", "Sodium source split",
    "Scenario 2 (LSS)", "Scenario 4 (LSS)", "Scenario 5 (LSS)", "Population uptake",
    "Adherence", "Full package", "Fiscal low / base / high", "SSaSS trial benchmark",
    "Sodium → SBP → CVD", "Case fatality", "Baseline"),
  Definition = c(
    "Baseline cardiovascular deaths minus scenario deaths, summed over the results window. Because these policies lower incidence (not case fatality), deaths are shifted later rather than permanently removed.",
    "The country- and year-specific fraction of total sodium intake removed by a scenario, obtained by weighting each policy's source-specific reduction by that source's share of intake.",
    "Baseline sodium is divided into five sources (discretionary, packaged, restaurant, public/institutional and inherent) that sum to 100%; each policy acts only on the sources it can reach.",
    "Whole-population replacement of discretionary salt with a low-sodium salt substitute, reported at 10–50% population uptake.",
    "Low-sodium salt substitute for adults with diagnosed hypertension.",
    "Low-sodium salt substitute for adults with treated hypertension.",
    "The share of the target population that adopts the intervention (population reach).",
    "The fraction of a user's salt that is actually the substitute (SSaSS year-5 ≈ 0.92).",
    "The combined public procurement + salt targets + front-of-pack labelling + fiscal policy, run jointly.",
    "The full package evaluated with the low, base or high fiscal-policy variant.",
    "An alternative low-sodium salt estimate using the SSaSS trial's stroke relative risks; applies only to hypertension populations and stroke outcomes.",
    "The modelled causal chain: less sodium (and, for substitutes, more potassium) lowers systolic blood pressure, which lowers cardiovascular disease incidence.",
    "The probability that a person with disease dies of it in a year; held at baseline for sodium→blood-pressure policies.",
    "The no-intervention projection against which all scenarios are compared."),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------- tr-bundle -------
# Canonical Word-appearance order: this MUST match the order in which the table and
# figure chunks appear in docs/technical-report.RMD, because bookdown numbers them
# by appearance. The workbook mirrors these numbers, so the two match exactly (a QA
# check cross-verifies the rendered caption numbers against these).
# (Comment 7) eff_evidence merged into eff_brief and dropped from the order.
TABLE_ORDER <- c("countries", "eff_brief", "main", "lss", "bycause", "limitations",
  "scn_def", "fiscal_path", "nak_ssass", "source_shares", "ncd_elig",
  "baseline_k", "pkg_trend", "key_inputs", "lss_audit", "huang", "benchmark",
  "scn_summary", "saxena")
# Figure order MUST match the chunk appearance order in docs/technical-report.RMD.
# (Comment D added state_transition; comment E removed fiscal_pathway; comment G
# removed bycause.)
FIGURE_ORDER <- c("framework", "shares", "map", "packaged_time", "lss_pathway",
  "state_transition", "headline", "lss_uptake", "countries")

TABLE_ORDER  <- TABLE_ORDER[TABLE_ORDER %in% names(TAB)]
FIGURE_ORDER <- FIGURE_ORDER[FIGURE_ORDER %in% names(FIG)]
for (i in seq_along(TABLE_ORDER))  TAB[[TABLE_ORDER[i]]]$num  <- i
for (i in seq_along(FIGURE_ORDER)) FIG[[FIGURE_ORDER[i]]]$num <- i
for (k in names(TAB)) TAB[[k]]$id <- paste0("Table ",  TAB[[k]]$num)
for (k in names(FIG)) FIG[[k]]$id <- paste0("Figure ", FIG[[k]]$num)
# (Comment 2) Stable, Word-safe internal bookmark names (letter-initial; letters,
# digits, underscores only) kept SEPARATE from the human-readable "Table N"/"Figure N".
for (k in names(TAB)) TAB[[k]]$bkm <- paste0("tbl_", k)
for (k in names(FIG)) FIG[[k]]$bkm <- paste0("fig_", k)

TR <- list(
  meta = list(
    generated       = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    n_countries     = n_pri,
    country_order   = country_order,
    window          = WINDOW,
    scaleup         = c(SCALEUP_YEAR1, SCALEUP_YEAR2),
    # (Comment 5) 2017 initialises the transition history; 2019 is the pre-pandemic
    # epidemiologic seed/reference year; projection runs annually to the horizon.
    initialization_year   = RC$analysis_years[1],
    epidemiologic_seed_year = 2019L,
    horizon         = RC$analysis_years[2],
    results_years   = RC$impact_years,
    scenarios       = as.data.frame(as.data.table(RC$scenarios)),
    lss             = RC$lss, fiscal = RC$fiscal, euromonitor = RC$euromonitor,
    # (Comment 9) factual assumptions, stated without status labels.
    assumptions     = c("Public food procurement is modelled using an assumed 5% institutional share of sodium.",
                        "Nigeria's sodium-source profile is applied to Cameroon because a country-specific profile was unavailable.",
                        "Results are point estimates and do not include full probabilistic uncertainty.")),
  nums = TRnums, dict = DICT,
  tab = TAB, fig = FIG,
  table_order = TABLE_ORDER, figure_order = FIGURE_ORDER,
  style = TR_STYLE, palette = RTSL,
  assets_dir = "report_assets")

saveRDS(TR, file = file.path(ra_dir, "tr_bundle.rds"))
cat("tr-bundle: wrote", file.path(ra_dir, "tr_bundle.rds"), "with",
    length(TABLE_ORDER), "tables and", length(FIGURE_ORDER), "figures.\n")
```

```{r tr-xlsx, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tr-xlsx ----
# docs/technical-report.xlsx, built from the SAME prepared objects that feed the
# Word report so the two can never diverge. Sheets: Contents, Dictionary, one per
# table, one per data figure (image + plotted data), a Diagrams sheet, and a
# Figure index. Table/figure identifiers match the Word report exactly.
wb <- createWorkbook()
hdr   <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = RTSL$purple, fontColour = "white",
                     halign = "center", valign = "center", border = "TopBottomLeftRight",
                     borderColour = "#DDDDDD", wrapText = TRUE)
ttl   <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 13, fontColour = RTSL$purple)
meta_s<- createStyle(fontSize = 9, fontColour = "#555555")
labur <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fontSize = 9, fontColour = "#333333")
wrapc <- createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top")

short_of <- function(key) {
  s <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", key)))
  substr(s, 1, 18)
}
sheet_name <- function(prefix, num, key) {
  nm <- sprintf("%s%02d_%s", prefix, num, short_of(key))
  substr(nm, 1, 31)
}

write_meta_block <- function(sheet, tabobj) {
  writeData(wb, sheet, paste0(tabobj$id, ". ", tabobj$title), startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  rows <- list(c("Units", tabobj$units), c("Period", tabobj$period),
               c("Population", tabobj$population), c("Scenario", tabobj$scenario_def),
               c("Rounding", tabobj$rounding), c("Source", tabobj$source),
               c("Notes", tabobj$notes))
  rows <- Filter(function(r) nzchar(r[2]), rows)
  r <- 2
  for (rr in rows) {
    writeData(wb, sheet, rr[1], startCol = 1, startRow = r)
    writeData(wb, sheet, rr[2], startCol = 2, startRow = r)
    addStyle(wb, sheet, labur, rows = r, cols = 1)
    addStyle(wb, sheet, meta_s, rows = r, cols = 2)
    r <- r + 1
  }
  r + 1  # first free row after a blank line
}

# ---- Contents sheet (placeholder rows filled after sheets exist) ------------
addWorksheet(wb, "Contents", tabColour = "#1F4E5F")
contents <- data.frame(Reference = character(), Title = character(),
                       Sheet = character(), Type = character(),
                       check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ---- Table sheets -----------------------------------------------------------
tab_sheets <- character(0)
for (key in TR$table_order) {
  tb <- TAB[[key]]
  sh <- sheet_name("T", tb$num, key); tab_sheets[key] <- sh
  addWorksheet(wb, sh)
  first <- write_meta_block(sh, tb)
  df <- tb$display
  writeData(wb, sh, df, startRow = first, startCol = 1, headerStyle = hdr,
            borders = "all", borderColour = "#E0E0E0")
  setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1:ncol(df), widths = "auto")
  setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1, widths = 26)
  addStyle(wb, sh, wrapc, rows = (first + 1):(first + nrow(df)),
           cols = 1:ncol(df), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb, sh, firstActiveRow = first + 1)
  addFilter(wb, sh, rows = first, cols = 1:ncol(df))
  contents <- rbind(contents, data.frame(Reference = tb$id, Title = tb$title,
    Sheet = sh, Type = "Table", check.names = FALSE))
}

# ---- Figure sheets (image + plotted data) & Diagrams ------------------------
fig_sheets <- character(0)
diagram_keys <- c()
for (key in TR$figure_order) {
  fg <- FIG[[key]]
  if (is.null(fg$data)) { diagram_keys <- c(diagram_keys, key); next }
  sh <- sheet_name("F", fg$num, key); fig_sheets[key] <- sh
  addWorksheet(wb, sh)
  writeData(wb, sh, paste0(fg$id, ". ", fg$title), startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sh, ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  if (nzchar(fg$notes)) { writeData(wb, sh, fg$notes, startCol = 1, startRow = 2)
    addStyle(wb, sh, meta_s, rows = 2, cols = 1) }
  img <- file.path(ra_dir, fg$file)
  insertImage(wb, sh, img, width = min(fg$w, 7.5), height = min(fg$w, 7.5) * fg$h / fg$w,
              startRow = 4, startCol = 1, units = "in")
  drow <- 4 + ceiling(min(fg$w, 7.5) * fg$h / fg$w * 5.2) + 2
  writeData(wb, sh, "Plotted data", startCol = 1, startRow = drow - 1)
  addStyle(wb, sh, labur, rows = drow - 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb, sh, fg$data, startRow = drow, startCol = 1, headerStyle = hdr,
            borders = "all", borderColour = "#E0E0E0")
  setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1:ncol(fg$data), widths = "auto")
  contents <- rbind(contents, data.frame(Reference = fg$id, Title = fg$title,
    Sheet = sh, Type = "Figure (+data)", check.names = FALSE))
}
# Diagrams sheet (schematics with no data)
if (length(diagram_keys)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, "Diagrams")
  writeData(wb, "Diagrams", "Schematic diagrams (no underlying data)", startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
  addStyle(wb, "Diagrams", ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  rr <- 3
  for (key in diagram_keys) {
    fg <- FIG[[key]]; fig_sheets[key] <- "Diagrams"
    writeData(wb, "Diagrams", paste0(fg$id, ". ", fg$title), startCol = 1, startRow = rr)
    addStyle(wb, "Diagrams", labur, rows = rr, cols = 1)
    insertImage(wb, "Diagrams", file.path(ra_dir, fg$file),
                width = 7.5, height = 7.5 * fg$h / fg$w, startRow = rr + 1, startCol = 1, units = "in")
    rr <- rr + ceiling(7.5 * fg$h / fg$w * 5.2) + 3
    contents <- rbind(contents, data.frame(Reference = fg$id, Title = fg$title,
      Sheet = "Diagrams", Type = "Figure (schematic)", check.names = FALSE))
  }
}

# ---- Figure index sheet -----------------------------------------------------
addWorksheet(wb, "Figure_Index")
fidx <- rbindlist(lapply(TR$figure_order, function(key) {
  fg <- FIG[[key]]
  data.table(Figure = fg$id, Title = fg$title,
             `Image sheet` = if (!is.null(fig_sheets[key])) fig_sheets[key] else "Diagrams",
             `Data sheet`  = if (!is.null(fg$data)) fig_sheets[key] else "(schematic, no data)")
}))
writeData(wb, "Figure_Index", "Figure index", startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
addStyle(wb, "Figure_Index", ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
writeData(wb, "Figure_Index", as.data.frame(fidx), startRow = 3, headerStyle = hdr,
          borders = "all", borderColour = "#E0E0E0")
setColWidths(wb, "Figure_Index", cols = 1:4, widths = c(12, 52, 20, 24))
freezePane(wb, "Figure_Index", firstActiveRow = 4)

# ---- Dictionary sheet -------------------------------------------------------
addWorksheet(wb, "Dictionary")
writeData(wb, "Dictionary", "Scenario and terminology dictionary", startCol = 1, startRow = 1)
addStyle(wb, "Dictionary", ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
writeData(wb, "Dictionary", DICT, startRow = 3, headerStyle = hdr,
          borders = "all", borderColour = "#E0E0E0")
setColWidths(wb, "Dictionary", cols = 1:2, widths = c(30, 110))
addStyle(wb, "Dictionary", wrapc, rows = 4:(3 + nrow(DICT)), cols = 2, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
freezePane(wb, "Dictionary", firstActiveRow = 4)

# ---- Fill Contents ----------------------------------------------------------
writeData(wb, "Contents", "Sodium Interventions Model: Technical Report workbook",
          startCol = 1, startRow = 1); addStyle(wb, "Contents", ttl, rows = 1, cols = 1)
writeData(wb, "Contents", paste0("Generated ", TR$meta$generated,
  ". Deaths delayed are cardiovascular deaths delayed vs. baseline over ", WINDOW,
  ", across ", n_pri, " countries. Values are finalised in the report; do not recompute here."),
  startCol = 1, startRow = 2); addStyle(wb, "Contents", meta_s, rows = 2, cols = 1)
writeData(wb, "Contents", as.data.frame(contents), startRow = 4, headerStyle = hdr,
          borders = "all", borderColour = "#E0E0E0")
setColWidths(wb, "Contents", cols = 1:4, widths = c(12, 62, 22, 18))
freezePane(wb, "Contents", firstActiveRow = 5); addFilter(wb, "Contents", rows = 4, cols = 1:4)

xlsx_path <- file.path(wd, "docs", "technical-report.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_path, overwrite = TRUE)

# openxlsx 4.2.8 writes a drawing/vmlDrawing relationship for EVERY worksheet but
# only materialises the drawing XML for image sheets, leaving orphaned references
# that make Excel prompt to repair. Strip the broken (missing-target) relationships
# so the workbook opens cleanly. The dropped rels are unreferenced by the sheet XML.
repair_xlsx_drawings <- function(path) {
  resolve_part <- function(base_dir, target) {
    parts <- unlist(strsplit(paste0(base_dir, "/", target), "/")); out <- character(0)
    for (p in parts) { if (p == "..") out <- out[-length(out)]
      else if (p == "." || p == "") next else out <- c(out, p) }
    paste(out, collapse = "/")
  }
  tmp <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("xlsxfix_", as.integer(runif(1, 1, 1e7))))
  unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = tmp)
  all_parts  <- list.files(tmp, recursive = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)
  exists_part <- function(p) p %in% all_parts
  n_dropped <- 0L
  for (rf in list.files(file.path(tmp, "xl", "worksheets", "_rels"),
                        pattern = "[.]rels$", full.names = TRUE)) {
    x <- paste(readLines(rf, warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
    tags <- regmatches(x, gregexpr("<Relationship [^>]*/>", x))[[1]]
    keep <- vapply(tags, function(tg)
      exists_part(resolve_part("xl/worksheets", sub('.*Target="([^"]*)".*', "\\1", tg))),
      logical(1))
    n_dropped <- n_dropped + sum(!keep)
    writeLines(paste0('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>',
      '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">',
      paste(tags[keep], collapse = ""), '</Relationships>'), rf, sep = "")
  }
  ct <- file.path(tmp, "[Content_Types].xml")
  y <- paste(readLines(ct, warn = FALSE), collapse = "")
  for (tg in regmatches(y, gregexpr("<Override [^>]*/>", y))[[1]]) {
    pn <- sub('.*PartName="([^"]*)".*', "\\1", tg)
    if (!exists_part(sub("^/", "", pn))) y <- sub(tg, "", y, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  writeLines(y, ct, sep = "")
  unlink(path)
  zip::zip(zipfile = path, files = all_parts, root = tmp)
  n_dropped
}
.nfix <- tryCatch(repair_xlsx_drawings(xlsx_path), error = function(e) {
  warning("xlsx drawing repair skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)); NA_integer_ })
cat("tr-xlsx: wrote", xlsx_path, "with", length(names(wb)), "sheets (repaired",
    .nfix, "broken drawing rels).\n")
```
